notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.content:
Support for IOUA is back. I plan to add some small updates and a major update before the end of the year.

Link to the video: https://youtu.be/MRiCLzCBPhM?si=NNZsKqzdiw2NDKFG

The walkthrough is essentially just a yap session with myself, apologies for the clickity clackity keyboard and mouse.

(This update has no new content and is just the walkthrough.)

notes.title: IOUA 1.02
notes.content:
New DEV walkthrough coming soon with answers to all puzzles in the game including some insight to how to solve them. 

You can find it here : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9EcE_1RPo3Y&ab_channel=hiiijacko

Also, minor bug fixes mainly to do with text. The build should be live later today.
